Positioned in geostationary orbit, the satellite is equipped with advanced sensors, including hyperspectral, multispectral, and thermal imaging, to collect high-resolution data on vegetation health, soil conditions, water resources, and disease patterns. Using AI and machine learning, the system processes this data to detect anomalies such as invasive species, crop diseases, and ecosystem degradation, presenting the results as interactive maps and predictive models. A user-friendly mobile and web app enables users to access real-time insights, control satellite data collection priorities, and receive alerts, making it a highly accessible tool for farmers, researchers, governments, and environmental organizations.
